datasets.title: Nepal - Disbursement of relief material in earthquake affected districts
datasets.description: This datasets contain list of all food and non food items which are disbursed by local bodies to earthquake victims. It was recorded by Nepal Disaster Risk Reduction Portal. Link : http://drrportal.gov.np/. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/disbursement-of-relief-material-in-earthquake-affected-districts]

lineage.description: Relief material disbursement records were collected by local bodies in earthquake-affected districts of Nepal and compiled by the Nepal Disaster Risk Reduction Portal. The dataset documents post-event humanitarian response through food and non-food item distributions, serving as an impact record of earthquake relief operations.
